prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was thinking about that trip back in 2025—everyone kept talking about taking the train from Beijing to Shanghai instead of flying.
And before that, I remember we stayed a couple nights in Beijing; my coworker kept joking that picking a hotel there was the hardest part of the whole week.
The funny part is my friend Zhang Wei already had everything set—he rode train G3 on 2025-03-12, and he said Second Class was totally fine.
Oh, and that bill situation is done too—someone in finance paid it ages ago; I still have the bill ID written down as BILL20260215004 for my notes.
